displayName: danMCai · 冠军表示语料与编码空洞统计
purpose: After the fixed cooperation grid found no preregistered interaction signal, quantify the deployed champion input ambiguity and preserve a complete-round clustered corpus for later read-only hidden/residual probes. No policy training or strength test.
resources: One Node process, explicitly CPU ONNX one thread; streaming per-complete-round binary buffers. No optimizer or new model export.
rollout: Four seats all ordinary017 raw argmax over canonical candidates; uniform level2..A and leader, independent108-card deals, no preceding round/tribute/full-match objective. Stop checks before every decision;1000-turn truncation errors.
stopping: Finish complete deals until at least1000000 decisions, then stop. The final complete deal may add at most999 extra rows. At most20000 reserved deal seeds, once-only2h window or original campaign cutoff; no expansion or extension. An incomplete current deal is discarded; committed complete-deal rows remain. Existing data refuses restart/overwrite.

schemaDescription.features.i8: [N,567] exact ordinary513-state plus chosen54-action, checked lossless Int8; public/acting-hand only.
schemaDescription.extras.f32: [N,53] chosen-action public/own supplementary features, not passed to ordinary policy.
schemaDescription.labels.f32: [N,11]:chosenQ,finalSignedPoints,finishingRank,trickPresent,relativeTrickOwnerOrNone,passes,partnerLeading,partnerHasBomb,ownHandCount,blindKind,level. Privileged labels only for future diagnostic targets.
schemaDescription.candidate-values.f32: Ragged row-major rawQ values, lengths from candidateCount; no Q-based action change beyond raw argmax.
schemaDescription.deals.json: Complete-deal row spans and all/choice-only blind counts; never split decisions from a deal across fitting/validation.

blindKind.0: At least one deployed last-action slot contains a positive card count
blindKind.1: Both slots non-play, actual lead, no out sentinel
blindKind.2: Both slots non-play, actual follow, no out sentinel
blindKind.3: Both slots non-play, actual lead, at least one out sentinel
blindKind.4: Both slots non-play, actual follow, at least one out sentinel

statistics: Report all-decision and choice-only ratios plus95% ratio-linearization intervals clustered by complete independent deal; counts by blind category. Do not treat decisions as independent. This uses independent single rounds rather than linked full matches, so the cluster unit is the entire deal trajectory.
nextCondition: Only if both all/choice-only upper95% frequency bounds are below5% may this frequency criterion close the input route. Otherwise separately preregister hidden/raw-input linear probes and G-Q versus extras ridge analysis. Frequency alone never establishes useful residual R2 or authorizes extras/teammate online training.
boundaries: no Clint or original policy used to generate this corpus
no online extras, live calibratedTop5 or deployment
no edits to prior frozen runs, catalog or original deadline
freeze: Resolve the commit containing this design to a detached runtime; sign source files, complete protocol and deadline before registration.
